_comment: Tracking (STB) of run 20260727 / 10Hz_r_b_1 with the new flat-window calibration (2026-10-04-plan.md). Lengths in mm, image coordinates in px. Paths relative to case_dir unless absolute.

camfiles._comment: old: the GUI's calibration after VSC, used by the old run (config.txt); new: the delivered flat-window wand calibration (case plate_20260727_T0, W4c). Camera i is CSV/camFile camera i = image folder cam(i+1) = photo C(i+1).

channel._comment: Inside widths across each camera wall (the user's channel, 15 x 10 cm inside, C1/C2 on the long side; held in the calibration). The near (camera-side) walls come from the new camFiles' plates: cams 0-1 wall_C1C2, cams 2-3 wall_C3C4.

frames._comment: T4 ran with frame range 0-1000 and was stopped after frame 504 (user's choice on 4 Oct: it had slowed to 32 s/frame); T5 runs 0-500, so the two compare over 0-500.
